important_scope_note: Control is a same-dataset linear margin ridge benchmark, not the exact live production SP+/curated-HFA model. The SportsDataverse historical table does not contain all live production inputs.
venue_limitation: Neutral-site metadata is unavailable in this canonical table. The experiment uses a symmetric home/away indicator and does not claim curated team-specific historical HFA.
market_note: Historical spread is used only as an evaluation benchmark. This dataset does not preserve timestamped open/current/close snapshots, so this report does NOT claim historical CLV.

decision.note: Promotion status is a model-development gate only. It is not a claim of guaranteed betting profitability.
